What is HTML?
HTML stands for Hyper Text Markup Language, which is the most widely used language on Web to develop web pages.
Who created HTML?
HTML was created by Berners-Lee in late 1991.
What are the different versions of HTML?
HTML was first published in 1995 as HTML 2.0, then in 1999 as HTML 4.01, and currently we have HTML-5 version published in 2012.
Who is the target audience for this tutorial?
This tutorial is designed for aspiring Web Designers and Developers with a need to understand HTML in enough detail along with its simple overview, and practical examples.
What are the prerequisites for this tutorial?

Before proceeding with this tutorial, you should have a basic working knowledge with Windows or Linux operating system, additionally you must be familiar with: experience with any text editor like notepad, notepad++, or Edit plus etc., how to create directories and files on your computer, how to navigate through different directories, how to type content in a file and save them on a computer, understanding about images in different formats like JPEG, PNG format.

What are the main formatting elements in HTML?
HTML provides several formatting elements such as bold text, italic text, underlined text, strike text, and monospaced font.
How do you apply bold text in HTML?
You apply bold text using the <b> tag or the <strong> tag.
What is the difference between <b> and <strong> tags?
<b> is used for stylistic text, while <strong> is used to indicate strong importance.
How do you apply italic text in HTML?
You apply italic text using the <i> tag or the <em> tag.

What are the main sections of an HTML document?
The main sections of an HTML document include the <head> and <body> tags.

The <head> tag contains meta-information about the document, such as the title, character set, and scripts.
What is the purpose of the <body> tag in an HTML document?
The <body> tag contains the content of the document, such as text, images, and links.

What is the purpose of the <table> tag in HTML?
The <table> tag is used to create a table in HTML.
What are the attributes used to style a table in HTML?
The cellpadding and cellspacing attributes are used to style a table in HTML.
What is the difference between colspan and rowspan attributes in HTML?
Colspan allows a cell to span multiple columns, while rowspan allows a cell to span multiple rows.
How can I add a background color to a table in HTML?
